### Prerequisite edges (each listed separately)
1. CD → application fee, form state: "The lender credits on a Closing Disclosure are fixed only after the fee ledger carries the application fee collected on the file, wherever the program the file is in charges an application fee." Verbatim in doc_loan_initial_closing_disclosure_issuance_9f610a07 only. Resolution: payment doc describes the write in the same words ("booked … application fee collection"). Strength/connective intact.
2. CD → cure, form state: "The lender credits on a Closing Disclosure are not fixed until every zero-tolerance increase over the good-faith baseline has a cure entry assessed on the file." Verbatim in the same hub only. Resolution: cure-booking doc ("Books a TRID tolerance cure … One call adds one assessed cure"), measured-increase worksheet, records (3029.90 vs 2879.90). Intact.
3. Cure → revised LE, form state: "A zero-tolerance cure is assessed only after the latest Loan Estimate on the file carries the changed circumstance documented most recently on the file." Verbatim in doc_loan_zero_tolerance_cure_booking_bbcf7ee2 only, with a same-form restatement. Resolution: revised-LE hub ("names the changed circumstance it rests on … documented date … lock request log") + records (lock request 2026-10-13 vs latest LE CoC 2026-08-21). Intact.
4. Revised LE → application fee, form state: "The zero-tolerance total on a revised Loan Estimate is not fixed until the fee ledger shows the application fee actually collected on the file, wherever the program the file is in charges an application fee." Verbatim in doc_loan_revised_loan_estimate_issuance_b6c0f117 only, with a same-form restatement ("for every other program, a file whose fee ledger shows no application fee collection does not yet have a fixed zero-tolerance total"). Intact.

## dependency_form
- Four prerequisite sentences, each verbatim only on its blocked side, with same-form restatements only in the same document. Not RED.
- No state-form sentence restated as an action: the CD hub never says "pay the application fee", "assess a cure" or "issue a revised LE". No other problem's tool is named in any hub (each tool name appears only in its own invocation document).
- No document aggregates the chain (fee → revised LE → cure → CD) as a table, checklist, route or ordered steps. No FAQ or example walks across problems.
- Titles are general subjects; none mirrors task 1 (no "closing moved / first CD / lock extension" situation title).
- Depended-on documents are reachable through record/sentence words ("application fee collection", "cure entry assessed", "Loan Estimate … changed circumstance … lock request log").
- Computation documents carry only source baseline and assembly text; none hints at variations, points elsewhere, or lists exceptions. Factor documents point at no other document and say no tier a customer falls on.
- Observation (judged not RED): doc_loan_hometown_heroes_fee_discount_3df6e432 says "The occupation is the occupation verified on that credit, not one the customer states on the call." Task 1's caller calls himself an "emergency-room nurse", so this sentence bears on the task. It restates the source's own authority condition ("its verified occupation"), it is general, and it names no tier any customer falls on. It works like the corpus's base evidence-authority sentences (e.g. "not the customer's recollection"), so it is not the mistake-naming form that 3b targets. It is listed here so the coordinator can weigh it.
- **PASS.**

## Policy-side / cross-product notes (no verdict effect)
- Task 1's 2026-10-13 extension entry carries 5 Larkspur-borne days of 10 but cost_bearer borrower and cost 368.00. Source and KB both read "borrower-borne extension entries" by cost and say that a lock extension caused by a Larkspur delay is never a changed circumstance. The source does not define a partially Larkspur-borne extension, and the KB does not close that question either (render Value 0). The record's cost_bearer settles it here.
- Short-notice credit measures from "the day the Closing Disclosure is prepared", while the CD is dated the next business day. Both 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 fall in the ≤7-day tier, so the openness is not exercised.
- Cross-product: the lock product books Larkspur waivers against borrower-borne extension charges (doc_lock_appraisal_delay_extension_waivers_…). The loan lock-line and lock-exclusion factors add or take out the extension's "dollar cost" and say nothing about a waived extension. Task 1 has no waiver entry (the appraisal was delivered on its due date), so there is no effect here. It is an untriggered cross-product boundary.
- Cross-product: the credit product's Heroes occupation supplement treats nurse as "any other occupation" for a different quantity. That does not touch the loan factors.
- Base known issue B-1 is BLUEPRINT-KNOWN (coordinator) and was not re-judged.
